findings.phone_builtin_tailscale: off, confirmed in Network preferences before any settings changes
findings.phone_system_vpn: active Tailscale VPN; Mac server identifies the client as shulhis-s22
findings.client_bug: network online=false or force=true called lose_connections even when the control/data sockets remained usable

change: Retain established sockets, ownership, queued work and in-flight input across route callbacks. Reconnect after actual socket failure; wait for network availability before a replacement handshake. Explicit retry/disconnect still works.

validation.physical_device: Samsung S22+; isolated renderbench test package
validation.live_handoff_test: Passed against a disposable Rex server: five offline/online/force callbacks preserved the same connectionEpoch
validation.failure_recovery: Native regression verifies a real I/O error enters reconnecting and waits until network returns

limits: Does not make a broken TCP path migrate by itself; Tailscale/Android supplies route migration. Actual transport failure still requires reconnecting.
No live Wi-Fi/mobile-network switches were forced on the user phone.
Server logs alone do not prove that every reported MBP disconnection had this cause.
